criterion: Step count / One way per task
description: There is no Rotate action. Replacing a leaked key takes about 10 actions across the console and a terminal, and the instruction exists only as one sentence at the bottom of the terminal panel. The user who just pasted a key into a chat has the urgent task of replacing it without downtime, which is the product's own recommended flow.
expected: A 'Replace' action on a key row that pre-fills the new key (same agent, drives, scopes), shows the secret once with a ready login command, then offers 'Revoke old key' in the same dialog.
actual: Header '+ New API key' opens a blank dialog; old key must be found and revoked separately.
suggested_fix: Add 'Replace key' to each active row that opens the dialog pre-filled and, on completion, prompts to revoke the old key.

description: The Create API key dialog defaults to the first agent alphabetically (a read-only one, 'assistant') and the first drive (nightly-builds), not to the agent and drive the user is working on. To rotate, the user must change the agent, uncheck the wrong drive and check the right one; skipping that creates a key for the wrong agent without any warning.
expected: Pre-select from context (the key being replaced, or the agent in the filter), and show a summary line before create.
suggested_fix: Start with no agent selected (placeholder) or pass the row's agent when opened from a row.

description: Key rows cannot be told apart beyond free-text labels: no key id, created date, last-used time or machine. 'nightly laptop' and 'nightly laptop 2' look alike, so revoking the wrong one (the story's variation) is easy and the 02:00 job would fail. The new key row also lacks 'issued by research-bot' while the old one has it.
expected: Show a short key id or created date and last used; consistent provenance text.
suggested_fix: Add 'created Nov 6 · last used 2 min ago' to the meta line.

description: The save-secret dialog says to use the key 'with agent-drive login' but gives no command. The terminal panel recommends 'read -rs ... agent-drive login --api ...' while the CLI also supports --token-stdin for automation, which the story's step 7 uses; neither the dialog nor the panel shows the one-line unattended form.
expected: A copyable command with the real origin, for example printf '%s' "$KEY" | agent-drive login --api <origin> --token-stdin.
suggested_fix: Add the command with a Copy button under the secret.

description: The success notice behaves differently by viewport: on desktop it is inline in the page header (off-screen after scrolling to a row near the bottom, so no visible confirmation after Revoke); on a 390px viewport it is a fixed toast at the bottom with a Dismiss link. Also the story says the scope list includes Notes, which the dialog does not offer (catalog text drift).
expected: One notice pattern that is always visible.
suggested_fix: Use the bottom toast pattern at all widths.
